StatDef.label: water capacity
StatDef.description: How much water this draws from the ground or pumps into its plumbing, compared to normal. A well's own readout shows its ground capacity before this; the network's pump capacity includes it.

StatDef.label: sewage treated
StatDef.description: How fast this treats the sewage it holds, compared to normal.

StatDef.label: chance per day to foul its water
StatDef.description: The chance each day that this contaminates one water tower on its plumbing network, as a polluted well does. A working water filter on the network stops it.

StatDef.label: water lost per day
StatDef.description: The share of this tank's capacity that disappears from it each day.
